# 3. Applied Example

## Data Description and Context

## Load Data

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(baseballr)
library(tidyverse)

pitcher_ids <- c(
    "Gerrit Cole" = 543037,
    "Kevin Gausman" = 592332,
    "Logan Webb" = 657277,
    "Zack Wheeler" = 554430,
    "Sandy Alcantara" = 645261
)

# MLB season boundaries (2020 was COVID-shortened)
seasons <- list(
    list(start = "2019-03-28", end = "2019-09-29"),
    list(start = "2020-07-23", end = "2020-09-27"),
    list(start = "2021-04-01", end = "2021-10-03"),
    list(start = "2022-04-07", end = "2022-10-05"),
    list(start = "2023-03-30", end = "2023-10-01"),
    list(start = "2024-04-01", end = "2024-09-29")
)

# Generate week-by-week date ranges across all seasons
date_ranges <- map_dfr(seasons, function(s) {
    start_dates <- seq(as.Date(s$start), as.Date(s$end) - 6, by = "7 days")
    end_dates <- pmin(start_dates + 6, as.Date(s$end))
    tibble(start = start_dates, end = end_dates)
})

fetch_week <- function(start_dt, end_dt, i, n) {
    message(sprintf("[%d/%d] Pulling: %s to %s", i, n, start_dt, end_dt))

    df <- tryCatch(
        {
            statcast_search(
                start_date  = as.character(start_dt),
                end_date    = as.character(end_dt),
                player_type = "pitcher"
            )
        },
        error = function(e) {
            message(sprintf("[%d/%d] Error: %s", i, n, e$message))
            return(NULL)
        }
    )

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    df <- df %>%
        filter(
            pitcher %in% pitcher_ids,
            pitch_type == "FF"
        )

    Sys.sleep(3)
    return(df)
}

if (file.exists("data/hmm_data.csv")) {
    df <- read_csv("data/hmm_data.csv")
} else {
    # Pull all weeks across all seasons — this will take ~30+ minutes
    n_weeks <- nrow(date_ranges)
    raw_data <- pmap_dfr(
        list(date_ranges$start, date_ranges$end, seq_len(n_weeks), n_weeks),
        fetch_week
    )

    # Keep only pitcher-seasons with enough samples (min 200 FF pitches ~ 6-7 starts)
    min_pitches <- 200

    qualifying_seasons <- raw_data %>%
        mutate(season = lubridate::year(as.Date(game_date))) %>%
        group_by(player_name, season) %>%
        summarise(n_pitches = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        filter(n_pitches >= min_pitches) %>%
        # Only keep seasons where ALL pitchers qualify
        group_by(season) %>%
        filter(n() == length(pitcher_ids)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        select(player_name, season)

    df <- raw_data %>%
        mutate(season = lubridate::year(as.Date(game_date))) %>%
        semi_join(qualifying_seasons, by = c("player_name", "season")) %>%
        select(
            player_name, game_date, season,
            # pitch sequencing
            inning, at_bat_number, pitch_number,
            # velocity and spin
            release_speed, release_spin_rate,
            # movement
            pfx_x, pfx_z,
            # release mechanics
            release_extension,
            # count context
            balls, strikes
        )

    write_csv(df, "data/hmm_data.csv")
}
```
